title: Understanding the Span of X
text: The span of a matrix X refers to all possible linear combinations of its columns. If a vector Y is in the span of X, it means Y can be expressed as a combination of the columns of X. Consider what this implies about the relationship between Y and X in the context of linear regression.

hintAnswer: It can be expressed as a linear combination of the matrix's columns.
title: Exploring Linear Combinations
text: Which of the following statements is true about a vector being in the span of a matrix?
choices: It can be expressed as a linear combination of the matrix's columns.
It is orthogonal to the matrix.
It is a scalar multiple of the matrix.

title: OLS Model and Unique Solutions
text: In an OLS model, a unique solution for the parameters is found when the matrix X has full column rank. This means the columns of X are linearly independent. Think about how this affects the span of X and the vector Y.
